subject: Enable accept4() on *BSD (#13104)
reason: The change only widens the HAVE_ACCEPT4 preprocessor guard in src/config.h to define it on OpenBSD 5.7+, FreeBSD 10+ and NetBSD 8.0+. On Linux, where the fuzzer builds and runs, __linux__ already defined HAVE_ACCEPT4 before and after the change, so the compiled binaries are identical and no behaviour differs. The BSD-only accept4() path cannot be reached on this platform, so no scenario can test it here.
